title: RL Companion dev bridge v1
description: GENERATED from packages/contract/src/companion-dev-bridge.schema.ts and companion-dev-bridge-endpoints.schema.ts / companion-dev-bridge-snapshot.schema.ts / companion-dev-bridge-bg3.schema.ts / companion-dev-bridge-bg3-catalogue{,-report}.schema.ts — do not edit by hand. One $defs entry per /dev/v1/* body plus the probe request/result. Refinements enforced by the Zod schema but not expressible here: probe fn paths must pass allowlist.json (deny wins); exactly one of fn/presence per call; "$i" only with forEach; call ids unique; forEach.countFrom names an earlier fn call; ≤40 keys per result table; relative paths have no "..", drive or backslash; log lines hold no unredacted token (any letter case). Byte caps, measured as UTF-8 of the JSON serialisation: every response body ≤16 KiB, a probe request ≤4 KiB measured as its largest queue entry (output form + probeId, flavor padded to 34 chars), each probe-result item (a call without iterations, or one iteration) ≤3 KiB, a whole probe result ≤64 KiB. ledgerlink-snapshot: no string or table key holds a player GUID (Player-<digits>-<8 hex>); apis[].path unique; a call carries type (and no values) iff status is presence; each calls/apis/sections item ≤3 KiB, the head (snapshot minus those three arrays) ≤4 KiB, the whole snapshot ≤48 KiB (a ledgerlink-snapshot-page slice applies only the GUID and presence rules). bg3-saves / bg3-save-structure: no string or object key holds a GUID (32 hex split 8-4-4-4-12 by -, _, . or nothing, braced or not; a Larian h…g… handle, any case; ≥32 hex once every -, _, ., {, } is stripped) or a run of ≥10 decimal digits (saveRef exempt); saves[].saveRef, party[].slot and equipment[].slot within a party row unique; each bg3-save-structure party row ≤6 KiB. bg3-install / bg3-save-catalogue: the same GUID / digit guard; paks[].rel, party[].slot and items[].slot within a row unique; found:false ⇒ no paks; store null iff found is false; each matched entry part < its pak parts; resolvedName/resolvedRarity ≤ total; catalogueState absent/failed ⇒ every name and rarity null; each bg3-save-catalogue party row ≤12 KiB. collectors.bg3Catalogue: reason set iff state is absent/failed and from the list for that state; state ready ⇒ buildMs, builtAt, counts non-null; state absent ⇒ buildMs, builtAt, counts, lastLookup null; see CONTRACT.md.
